notes: Points follow FIBA Official Basketball Rules 2026 Art. 16.2.1: free throw 1, released from the 2-point area 2, from the 3-point area 3 (beyond the 6.75 m arc / 0.90 m corner lines; the line itself counts as 2).
Made shots and points are confirmed by the TV scoreboard where it is visible; elsewhere the value comes from the shooter's court position at release and is marked unconfirmed.
Shot made/missed without a scoreboard is decided from the ball seen below the rim; fast or hidden balls can be missed.
Interceptions include steals; possession changes after a shot (rebounds) are not counted.
Players without a confirmed jersey number are listed per track.
